{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Verify premises
# 1. 'completed' status means not refunded — confirmed by unique values
# 2. Internal test orders have revenue = 999999.99 — but we found 0 such rows
# 3. Revenue is stored as string with thousands separators — confirmed, e.g. '1,234.56' in examples

# Now, fix revenue: strip commas and convert to float
# But first, check if any revenue has commas
print("Revenue sample (before cleaning):", df['revenue'].head(5))

df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Now, filter: completed orders only, exclude test orders (revenue == 999999.99)
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']
valid_orders = completed_df[completed_df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Total revenue from completed valid orders
total_revenue = valid_orders['revenue_clean'].sum()

print(f"Total revenue from completed orders (excluding test orders): {total_revenue}")"}
